facebookresearch_projectariatools/projec.plot_box_wireframe: plot a 3D wireframe bounding box for a language entity with rotation, scale, and center
facebookresearch_projectariatools/projec.plot_point_cloud: plot a 3D point cloud from numpy array points with optional subsampling for large datasets
facebookresearch_projectariatools/projec.plot_trajectory: plot a 3D device trajectory with connected line markers from timestamped position data
facebookresearch_projectariatools/projec.review_PLOTTING_COLORS: review the PLOTTING_COLORS dictionary mapping entity classes like wall, door, window to hex color codes

facebookresearch_projectariatools/projec.read_language_file: read an ASE language file and parse scene commands with entity parameters into a list of tuples
facebookresearch_projectariatools/projec.read_trajectory_file: read a ground truth trajectory CSV file and return device poses with positions, rotations, and transforms
facebookresearch_projectariatools/projec.read_points_file: read a gzip-compressed semidense point cloud CSV file and return world coordinates as a numpy array
facebookresearch_projectariatools/projec.transform_from_Rt: build a 4x4 homogeneous transformation matrix from a rotation matrix and translation vector
facebookresearch_projectariatools/projec.read_trajectory_line: parse a single ground truth trajectory CSV line into a pose dictionary with position, rotation, and transform
